title: Singapore dollar weakness against the ringgit and support for local businesses ahead of the RTS Link
asked: Mr Yip Hon Weng asked what Singapore dollar-specific factors have caused persistent weakness against the Malaysian ringgit, what a sustained slide below 3 ringgit per Singapore dollar could mean for the labour market, and whether MAS would strengthen policy settings or adjust the exchange rate band.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said the Singapore dollar has appreciated against the ringgit at an average 1.3% per annum from 2020 to 2025, and that MAS manages the Singapore dollar against a trade-weighted basket of currencies rather than any bilateral rate. The trade-weighted exchange rate has gradually appreciated since October 2021, and the currency's strength and stability are assessed against medium-term price stability. Non-resident labour flows mainly reflect the economy's overall growth and employment prospects, and MAS will keep monitoring developments and can adjust its monetary policy stance.

key_points.point: The Singapore dollar appreciated against the Malaysian ringgit at an average rate of 1.3% per annum over 2020 to 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the Singapore dollar has appreciated against the Malaysian ringgit at an average rate of 1.3% per annum over 2020 to 2025.

key_points.point: MAS manages the Singapore dollar against a trade-weighted basket of currencies of major trading partners, not against any bilateral exchange rate.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: manages the Singapore dollar against a trade-weighted basket of currencies of its major trading partners and not against any bilateral exchange rate.

key_points.point: The Singapore dollar trade-weighted exchange rate has been on a gradual appreciating path since October 2021.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Singapore dollar trade-weighted exchange rate has been on a gradual appreciating path since October 2021.

key_points.point: The strength and stability of the Singapore dollar is assessed against the attainment of medium-term price stability.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The strength and stability of the Singapore dollar is assessed against the attainment of medium-term price stability in the economy.

key_points.point: Non-resident labour flows into Singapore principally reflect the economy's overall growth and employment prospects.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Non-resident labour flows into Singapore principally reflect the economy’s overall growth and employment prospects.

key_points.point: MAS will continue to closely monitor economic and financial developments and is in an appropriate position to adjust its monetary policy stance to ensure medium-term price stability.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: MAS will continue to closely monitor economic and financial developments and is in an appropriate position to adjust its monetary policy stance to ensure medium-term price stability.

key_points.point: Enhancements to grants and support for heartland businesses were announced in the MTI Committee of Supply.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we have also announced many enhancements to the grants and support for heartland businesses

key_points.point: The RTS Link Task Force met that morning with merchants and Government officials, including Enterprise Singapore, HDB and NEA.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We have met with the merchants. We have met with Government officials, including Enterprise Singapore, the Housing and Development Board, and the National Environment Agency this morning.

key_points.point: Measures will be announced in due course.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we will announce these measures in due course.
